feature: A deep Norwegian fjord seen from high above the water: sheer faceted cliff walls plunge into still dark water that mirrors the sky and winds away between the mountains, a thin waterfall ribbons down one cliff, and a tiny red boathouse with a wooden jetty sits on a grassy shelf by the water. Foreground: a bare rock ledge with heather and a few slender birches on one side only, leaving the view open.
